item.title: Kansas cell phone ban applying to both public and private schools clears House
item.description: TOPEKA — Cell phones are one step closer to disappearing from Kansas classrooms after the House passed a bill that would require a daytime device ban to public and private schools. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Senate overturns governor’s veto of anti-trans ‘bathroom bill’
item.description: The Kansas Senate overturned Gov. Laura Kelly’s veto on Tuesday, putting the state one step closer to forcing people to use bathrooms in government buildings that match their biological sex at birth. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Mardi Gras parade draws energetic crowd
item.description: The Lawrence Mardi Gras parade drew a crowd of energetic and festive paradegoers who sang, danced and cheered their way through downtown Lawrence Tuesday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence police, Douglas County Sheriff say they had no notice ahead of ICE arrests
item.description: Spokespeople for the Lawrence Police Department and the Douglas County Sheriff's Office said that neither agency was involved in Tuesday's ICE sightings and arrests, nor did they know they were coming. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commission general public comment for Feb. 17, 2026
item.description: Here’s the general public comment for the Lawrence City Commission’s Tuesday meeting, as public comment is no longer being broadcast. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Republicans force transgender bathroom restrictions into law, overriding a veto
item.description: Republicans in the Kansas Legislature have forced restrictions on bathroom use by transgender people into state law by overriding the governor’s veto. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas disaster declaration prepares state for World Cup visitor boom
item.description: The upcoming World Cup prompted Gov. Laura Kelly to declare a state of disaster emergency in Douglas and two other counties, anticipating effects from four base camps in the Kansas City-area. Continue reading ...

item.title: Report suggests solutions to help single mothers in Douglas County
item.description: Single mothers in Douglas County regularly endure overlapping struggles to find housing, food and health care, according to a report produced by the county, KU and a handful of other local agencies. Continue reading ...

item.title: Amy Helmer: Life, liberty, and the right to pee (Column)
item.description: "Fearmongering over the alleged safety risks of peeing is so deeply American, it is hardly surprising that the modern-day politician increasingly attempts to frame transgender people as political scapegoats," Amy Helmer writes in this column. Continue reading ...
